title: Comment rendering via textContent and a correctly ordered escaper
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag building DOM nodes as verbose, or the string escaper as a place an XSS could hide. User text is assigned through textContent, which the browser never parses as markup; the escaper exists only for the one legacy string-template call site, and it replaces & first — any other order would double-escape the entities it just introduced and corrupt output — then covers <, >, double and single quotes so values are safe in both element and attribute contexts.
